options: Route Service to routine year-over-year archive review

O.content: The blue circular mark is higher on the page than the red square mark.

O.location: left and right vertical axis labels
O.content: The left vertical label reads "2011" in blue, and the right vertical label reads "2030" in red.
"Service" is a printed category label beneath the compared marks.

B.text: If the blue 2011 series and red 2030 series are bound by the matching colored year labels, and vertical position encodes comparable Service support cost with higher marks meaning higher cost, then the higher Service mark identifies the entry for the higher-cost follow-up queue.
B.conditions: Applies to the Service category; assumes the unlabeled vertical scale represents the relevant comparable support-cost measure and that upward position denotes greater cost.

O.content: No y-axis metric name or numeric tick labels are visibly printed.
The blue circular mark and red square mark are at different vertical positions.

B.text: If the chart does not establish that its vertical positions encode the relevant support-cost measure or the direction of that measure, then it does not provide sufficient evidence to identify either year as higher cost; routine archive review remains the non-escalation alternative.
B.conditions: Applies because no visible y-axis metric label, tick values, or explicit cost legend is shown.
